title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Manual Modified Omega Bio-Tek E.Z.N.A.
author: Amy Denton

steps.title: Prepare Heat Block
steps.instruction: Set the heat block to the required temperature based on sample type.

substeps.instruction: For non-jellyfish samples: set to 60 °C
For jellyfish samples: set to 25 °C

steps.title: Prepare Sample Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare tubes based on the disruption method.

substeps.instruction: For samples requiring powermashing: label 1.5 mL BioMasher tubes and label/save sterile BioMasher pestles
For cryogenically disrupted samples (e.g., bead beating): label 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes
Transfer samples into the corresponding 1.5 mL BioMasher or 2 mL microcentrifuge tube

steps.title: Lysis and Proteinase K Addition
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffer and Proteinase K to the samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μL of ML1 buffer to all samples
For non-jellyfish samples: add 25 μL Proteinase K solution
For jellyfish samples: add 10 μL Proteinase K solution

steps.title: Homogenize Samples
steps.instruction: Homogenize samples according to sample type and disruption method.

substeps.instruction: For non-jellyfish cryogenically disrupted samples: pipette mix gently 10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip
For non-jellyfish samples requiring powermashing: use BioMasher pestle and Diagnocine PowerMasher II tissue disruptor following the PowerMash protocol
For jellyfish samples: manually disrupt using BioMasher pestle; return pestles to labeled sterile packets for later use

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate samples based on sample type.

substeps.instruction: For non-jellyfish samples: incubate for at least 30 minutes at 60 °C (extend to 45-60 minutes if not completely solubilized)
For jellyfish samples: incubate for 15 minutes at 25 °C, manually disrupting tissue with retained pestles halfway through

steps.title: Transfer to Microcentrifuge Tubes
steps.instruction: Ensure all samples are in 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer samples from 1.5 mL BioMasher tubes to fresh, labeled 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes using a wide-bore pipette tip
Samples already in 2 mL tubes do not require transfer

steps.title: Chloroform Separation
steps.instruction: Perform chloroform separation in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μL of chloroform:isoamyl (24:1) to each sample
Rotate samples on a HulaMixer™ at 8 rpm for 5 minutes
Centrifuge samples at 10,000 g for 2 minutes at room temperature
Using a wide-bore pipette tip, carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, avoiding the milky interphase

steps.title: RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Add BL buffer and RNase A, then incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 X volume of BL buffer (e.g., if 400 μL aqueous phase was recovered, add 400 μL BL buffer)
For non-jellyfish samples: add 10 μL RNase A and pipette mix 15 times with a wide-bore tip
For jellyfish samples: add 5 μL RNase A and pipette mix 15 times with a wide-bore tip
Incubate for 10 minutes at 70 °C for non-jellyfish samples, or 10 minutes at 25 °C for jellyfish samples

steps.title: Bead Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind DNA to beads and wash the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 to 800 μL vortexed Sera-Mag™ SpeedBead solution to each sample (volume depends on remaining tube volume)
Invert tubes 10 to 20 times to suspend beads, then allow at least 5 minutes for binding
Briefly centrifuge in a mini-centrifuge to collect beads at the bottom
Place tubes on a magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes (longer for viscous samples), then remove and discard supernatant
Add 1 mL 80% ethanol opposite the bead pellet, incubate for 30 seconds, then aspirate and discard
Repeat the ethanol wash for a total of two washes
Remove tubes from magnetic rack and add 200 μL Buffer AE directly to the beads
Mix 15 times using a wide-bore pipette tip to dislodge beads
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature, mixing gently halfway through and at the end
Briefly centrifuge in a mini-centrifuge, then place on a magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes
Carefully transfer the supernatant containing purified gDNA to fresh 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes using a 200 μL wide-bore pipette tip

steps.title: Second DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Perform a second elution to maximize yield.

substeps.instruction: Remove samples from magnetic rack and add 200 μL Buffer AE directly to the bead pellet
Incubate on the heat block for 3 minutes at 25 °C, shaking at 1,000 rpm
Briefly centrifuge in a mini-centrifuge, then place on a magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes
Carefully transfer the supernatant to the same 1.5 mL tubes used in the first elution using a wide-bore pipette tip
Pipette-mix 5 to 10 times to homogenize (total eluate volume will be 400 μL)

steps.title: SPRI Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the eluate using AMPure PB beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.45X AMPure PB beads (180 μL beads for 400 μL eluate) and mix 15 times with a wide-bore pipette tip
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature
Centrifuge in a mini-centrifuge for 1–2 seconds, then place on a magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes
Remove and discard the supernatant
Add 1 mL 80% ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds, then remove and discard
Repeat the ethanol wash for a total of two 80% ethanol washes

steps.title: Final Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Perform final elution and store the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Remove samples from magnetic rack and add 130 μL EB Buffer; pipette-mix 15 times with a wide-bore pipette
Incubate on a heat block for 30 minutes at 37 °C, shaking at 350 rpm
Return samples to the magnetic rack and transfer the supernatant into a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube
Incubate DNA at room temperature overnight
Perform QC the following morning and store DNA at 4 °C
